# LLM-powered semantic extraction and enrichment

Integrates optional LLM-backed semantic extraction for facts, and LLM-driven enrichment to infer links such as Jira Story→Feature motivations. Runs only when LLM is configured and enabled, with degraded paths and budget-exceeded handling.
